thread:
Sam: PR here -> https://git.internal/r/PR/8621. Changes add per-tenant routing + optional KV prefix cache. Gate: we need design/arch stamp (RFC) before merge. RFC is at https://docs.internal/rfc/tiling-routing-2026. @Mira (Design) @Priya (TL) can you take a quick look? looking for: acceptance criteria, SLO delta, and a short canary plan. hoping to merge in tomorrow's 14:00 release window if possible.
Asha: Ack. Quick skim looks close. Two asks: 1) add a small sequence diagram for request routing (where cache short-circuits), 2) call out the 95p latency change in the RFC. That'll make reviews much faster.
Jordan: Also watch for fallback path when a shard is full — need the runtime behavior spelled out (drop vs queue vs degrade). If devs can document the fallback and the expected token budget, that helps operations.
Mira (Design): Happy to check UX/behaviour. One quick product question: when route falls back to generic model, do we preserve tool-calling semantics? If not, need a note in RFC and a user-visible change log. I'll look at the doc now and comment inline.
Priya (TL): Thanks for the heads-up. If updates land by EOD today we can slot the PR for tomorrow's 14:00 merge window. If not, it'll be deferred 48h. Also request: link the canary traffic split and rollback criteria in the PR description.
CI Bot: ci/status: all checks queued -> running. fmt: OK, unit-tests: running.
Sam: Thanks — will add sequence diagram + explicit fallback section and update PR description with canary splits/rollback. Also will paste a short SLO impact table. ETA: ~3 hours.
Asha: If you can add a tiny table like:
```
SLO metric | baseline | expected
p95 latency | 120ms | 150-170ms
error rate  | 0.2%  | 0.3% (under load)
```
that helps signoff.
Sam: Added diagram and SLO table, pushed commit and updated PR desc: https://git.internal/r/PR/8621/commits/3f9b. Left inline comment linking new sections in RFC. Pinged @Mira and @Jordan for final checks.
Mira (Design): Reviewed the updated doc — UX part LGTM, added one tiny phrasing nit. Beyond that, design +1.
Priya (TL): Architecture note: +1 pending runtime confirmation. @Jordan can you validate the fallback behavior and confirm no hidden single-node failure modes? If you sign off we can merge in tomorrow's window.
Jordan: I'll run a quick dry-run on staging and validate shard full fallback and KV durability. Expect to have notes and a +1 by EOD. If anything shows up I'll post here.
Sam: Great — appreciate it. I'll hold the merge until we have Jordan's runtime check. I'll also add the rollback playbook snippet to the PR description per Priya's ask.
CI Bot: ci/status: unit-tests passed, integration-tests queued.
Sam: (follow-up) added rollback playbook, link in PR desc. pinging again when Jordan signs off.
